notes.title: Mr Nibbles Forever v46 Released
notes.content:
Just a small update this week.

Changelog:

+ Fixed a coupple of minor bugs
+ Improved the UI on the "dressing room" screen to make it more obvious that you can toggle powerups
+ Added a ton more chunks for more varied levels.

notes.title: Version 45 Released
notes.content:
Another small patch today for a couple of issues raised by some lovely nibblers emailing us.

Notes:

+ Fixed Mr Nibbles sometimes getting stuck in rotating tiles
+ The space suit is collectible again on the prize wheel
+ Fixed the nibble magnet not showing on the firestarter outfit

Please do email us: mike.cann@gmail.com if you notice any other issues or have suggestions!

notes.title: Mr Nibbles Forever v44 Released
notes.content:
Just a small update today to add a feature requested by Jen H. 

She asked for a way to log back into scores if you log out. It was always something we intended to add but never got round to, but now we have!

If you have any suggestions for things you would like to see implemented then email us: mike.cann@gmail.com or hit us up on twitter: @mikeysee

notes.title: Mr Nibbles Forever - v43 Released
notes.content:
Hey Nibblers,

Just a quick update from us at Nibble HQ today. We have fixed a couple of issues:

+ Hopefully fixed a long-standing issue where Mr Nibbles would sometimes appear at funny angles when leaving the spaceship.
+ Fixed it so that achievements should now be awarded for outfits unlocked during the beta.
+ Fixed the pixie outfit not unlocking properly, this should also now auto-unlocked for you if you have met the requirements.

Do let us know on the forums if you spot any other issues so we can get them fixed for you ASAP!

Cheers,
Mike
